method: Questbook placement, NOT earliest unlock. Prefer exact-name quests, then quests retrieving only one distinct controller, then broader quests. Tier chapters/named tier-entry gates anchor placement. The latest tier reference in ancestry supplies contextual placement, including alternative parents; it is not a claim that all OR parents are required. The separate earliestQuestUnlockHint respects AND/OR. When retrieval placement is unavailable, use the earliest identifiable tiered exact-name text mention. Recipe conflicts do not block an assumed quest tier. Predecessors/successors are recorded as context, never treated as a manufacturing proof.
